name: Guru
tagline: AI enterprise search on a verified company knowledge layer.
description: Guru is an enterprise knowledge platform combining AI search, a verified company wiki, and an intranet, surfacing trusted answers inside the tools teams already use. Knowledge Agents give departments like HR, sales, and support cited responses grounded in governed content, backed by 100+ integrations and a browser extension.
insight: Shipped a Slack MCP integration in March 2026, letting AI agents query live Slack conversations as a knowledge source.
edge: Grounds AI answers in a human-verified wiki with expiring 'trust' dates, so search returns governed knowledge instead of stale or hallucinated content.
pros: Strong browser extension and in-app delivery
cons: Pricing is now custom and sales-led

references.title: Guru vs Glean 2026: Why Verified AI Beats Enterprise Search
